description: This PHP test class verifies LDAP connection and authentication functionalities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup for mock services, test cases for creating LDAP connection parameters, and methods for generating mock LDAP entries for testing LDAP-related API endpoints.

classes.name: LDAPTestConnectionAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying LDAP connection and authentication functionalities within OrangeHRM. It uses mock services and LDAP entries to simulate LDAP server interactions and tests the LDAP API integration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, verifies LDAP server configuration, and loads server settings.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Main test method that sets up mock LDAP settings and services, invokes the LDAP connection test API, and asserts the response.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Helper method that creates a mock EntryCollection with specified LDAP entries and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Helper method that generates mock LDAP Entry objects from an array of usernames.
